rootCause: /templates/BM-001 rendered the legacy screenshot because TemplatePreviewWorkspace mounted <ContractV2Renderer uxProfile={...} /> where uxProfile = getRuntimeUxProfile('BM-001') returned null. No BM-001 runtime-ux profile existed; the renderer fell back to localizeSectionTitle() (which produced 'Thông tin bổ sung' for the two Vietnamese-titled sections) and to the generic getSampleData() heuristic (which leaks 'Nguyễn Văn A / Trần Thị B / 1980 / Ông  cung cấp...'). decideFormLifecycle() correctly returned panelKind='form-flight-runtime' for BM-001, but the workspace host never read panelKind.
whyPreviousPhaseInsufficient: FORM_LIFECYCLE_WIRING_CONTRACT centralised registration and the lifecycle decision but never created the visible-panel selector the host could read. The actual <ContractV2Renderer> mount kept using the legacy getRuntimeUxProfile() lookup, so the lifecycle decision was invisible to the rendered UI.
